cases.assertion: Review-case is the sole initial writer of its case artifact; campaign consumes an immutable digest-bound result reference.
Campaign attempts to rewrite immutable case fields or duplicate a case ID with different bytes fail closed.
Root materializes authorized child case evidence into contained Context inputs; support packs never traverse sibling parent paths.
A valid root-authorized campaign-to-case execution produces bound child evidence and aggregate input.
Child failure or cancellation remains visible, stops forbidden follow-on work, and cannot become campaign success.
Rejected or cancelled composition emits deterministic rollback evidence and preserves prior canonical records.
